Diagnosis & Assessment: Anterior cord syndrome predominating over central cord syndrome at C4-5 and C5-6, s/p ACDF at Regional Medical Center. She has made meaningful gains over the course of this year. She is ambulating with a cane for short indoor distances and continues to use the rollator outdoors. Bilateral AFOs remain in use.
Plan: She has reached a plateau in her neurological recovery consistent with the natural history of cord compression syndrome. I am placing her at maximum medical improvement effective today. She may continue her home exercise program independently. Follow-up on a PRN basis for acute flares. She is released to sedentary modified duty: no lifting greater than 10 lbs, sit/stand option required, bilateral AFO accommodation needed.
